name: Navigate pages and add a meal to the persistent bag
description: Verifies page navigation and that a selected meal is available in the bag after refresh.
steps: Filter to Nigerian meals and add Smoky Jollof Rice
expected: The separate menu and bag views work, the bag count and selected meal remain available after refresh.

name: Save a favourite and view the saved meals page
description: Checks the mobile navigation and favourites page use saved items.
steps: Open the menu on a mobile viewport
Tap the heart on a meal
Open Saved from the bottom navigation
expected: The saved meal appears on the separate Favourites page and remains saved after refresh.

name: Place a demo order and review order history
description: Checks checkout validation, total calculations and saved order summaries.
steps: Add two meals to the bag
Open My bag and continue to checkout
Enter a name and phone number and submit
expected: The demo order is recorded with its items, delivery address and total, and appears on the separate My orders page.

name: Search and filter the menu with no-results recovery
description: Verifies searching and sorting work and empty results provide a recovery action.
steps: Search for a phrase that matches no meals
expected: A clear empty state appears and the menu is restored when filters are cleared.
